items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002

ctx.x: Yeah. Because you know who first told me that was Art Blakey. Art Blakey used to accompany — and I knew Art before — but he says, “You know you’ve got a grandfather named Kaiser Marshall.” I says, “Well I don’t know, man.” Because the fact was that I never knew my father’s father. There was a big cloud of mystery around it.
